digest.component_or_area: test / interfaces / contracts / operation snapshot surfaces
propositions: The AC1 cross-surface equivalence contract vacuously re-calls the same composer with identical arguments across all surfaces instead of driving the real MCP and reconciler entry points, so it cannot catch parity bugs where those surfaces stop routing through the shared composer.

The MCP and reconciler test blocks must invoke real entry points (rebar.mcp_server.build_server + server.call_tool for MCP; rebar_reconciler.__main__.main with argv for reconciler) and capture their actual composed snapshots rather than re-composing with test arguments.

The test must anchor each surface's snapshot to absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, and config keys with distinct provenance) in addition to cross-surface equality comparison, because equal-to-each-other assertions remain vacuous under perturbations that move all surfaces together.

The recorder wrapping compose_operation_snapshot must fire for each surface; an empty capture list must fail with explicit surface-specific messaging to distinguish a surface that stopped routing through the composer from a passing assertion.

Integration points REBAR_VERIFY_MAX_TICKET_DESCRIPTION_CHARS (env layer) and sync.push (project layer) replace cli_overrides as the provenance anchors because MCP _shadow and reconciler _emit_operation_shadow pass no cli_overrides, making cli-only assertions inaccessible to those surfaces.
